menu.edit.title: Edit

@menu.edit.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word. macOS only.

menu.file.title: File

@menu.file.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word.

menu.view.title: View

@menu.view.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word.

menu.machine.title: Machine

@menu.machine.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word. Holds the emulated computer's commands.

menu.debug.title: Debug

@menu.debug.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word.

menu.build.title: Build

@menu.build.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word. Shown only for a project with a build file.

menu.help.title: Help

@menu.help.title.context: Top-level menu in the application menu bar. Keep it one short word.

@menu.app.about.context: macOS application menu: opens the About dialog.

@menu.app.installCli.context: macOS application menu: installs the 'klive' command for the terminal. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.app.hide.context: macOS application menu: hides the app's windows (standard macOS item).

@menu.app.hideOthers.context: macOS application menu: hides the other applications' windows (standard macOS item).

@menu.app.showAll.context: macOS application menu: shows every application's windows again (standard macOS item).

@menu.app.quit.context: macOS application menu: quits the app (standard macOS item).

@menu.edit.undo.context: Edit menu (macOS): undoes the last text edit.

@menu.edit.redo.context: Edit menu (macOS): redoes the undone text edit.

@menu.edit.cut.context: Edit menu (macOS): cuts the selected text.

@menu.edit.copy.context: Edit menu (macOS): copies the selected text.

@menu.edit.pasteAndMatchStyle.context: Edit menu (macOS): pastes text without its formatting (standard macOS item).

@menu.edit.delete.context: Edit menu (macOS): deletes the selected text.

@menu.file.newProject.context: File menu: creates a Klive project folder. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.openFolder.context: File menu: opens a folder as the IDE's project. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.openRecent.context: File menu: submenu of recently opened project folders.

@menu.file.openFile.context: File menu: opens any file the emulator understands (tape, snapshot, disk, state, RZX recording). The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.saveSnapshot.context: File menu: saves the ZX Spectrum's memory and registers as a snapshot file (.z80/.sna). The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.saveMachineState.context: File menu: saves the emulated machine's complete state to a file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.quickSaveState.context: File menu: saves the machine's state into a single in-memory slot, without a dialog.

@menu.file.quickRestoreState.context: File menu: restores the state saved by 'Quick Save State'.

@menu.file.closeFolder.context: File menu: closes the project folder open in the IDE.

@menu.file.settings.context: Opens the Settings dialog. In the File menu on Windows/Linux, in the application menu on macOS. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.file.exit.context: File menu on Windows: closes the application (the standard Windows wording).

@menu.file.quit.context: File menu on Linux: closes the application.

menu.automation.title: Automation

@menu.automation.title.context: Submenu (application menu on macOS, File menu elsewhere), shown while scripts can control Klive through its automation channel.

@menu.automation.showOutput.context: Automation submenu: shows the output pane that logs what scripts did.

@menu.automation.disconnectAll.context: Automation submenu: disconnects every connected script. Shown when none is connected (then disabled).

@menu.automation.disconnectAllCount.context: Automation submenu: disconnects every connected script; the number is how many are connected.

placeholders.count: Number of connected scripts, 1 or more

@menu.view.machineViews.context: View menu: submenu of documents that show the emulated machine (memory, disassembly, BASIC listing...).

@menu.view.memory.context: View › Machine Views: shows the memory dump document (checkbox).

@menu.view.disassembly.context: View › Machine Views: shows the disassembly document (checkbox).

@menu.view.toolbar.context: View menu checkbox: shows the toolbar of the focused window (IDE or emulator).

@menu.view.statusBar.context: View menu checkbox: shows the status bar of the focused window.

@menu.view.virtualKeyboard.context: View menu checkbox (emulator window): shows the on-screen keyboard of the emulated machine.

@menu.view.sidebar.context: View menu checkbox (IDE window): shows the side bar (explorer, debug panels...).

@menu.view.commandAndOutput.context: View menu checkbox (IDE window): shows the bottom panel with the command prompt and the output panes.

@menu.view.fitWindow.context: View menu (emulator window): resizes the window around the emulated screen.

@menu.view.fitWindow1x.context: View menu (emulator window): resizes the window around the emulated screen at its smallest (1x) zoom.

@menu.view.showIde.context: View menu: a checkbox item; checked while the IDE window is shown, toggling it shows or hides the IDE window.

@menu.view.goBack.context: View menu: goes back to the previous location in the IDE's navigation history.

@menu.view.goForward.context: View menu: goes forward in the IDE's navigation history.

@menu.view.zoom.context: View menu: submenu that zooms the window's whole user interface.

@menu.view.actualSize.context: View › Zoom: resets the window's zoom to 100% (standard item).

@menu.view.zoomIn.context: View › Zoom: makes the window's user interface larger.

@menu.view.zoomOut.context: View › Zoom: makes the window's user interface smaller.

@menu.view.toggleFullScreen.context: View menu: switches the focused window into or out of full-screen mode.

@menu.view.lightTheme.context: View menu: switches the colour theme from dark to light.

@menu.view.darkTheme.context: View menu: switches the colour theme from light to dark.

@menu.view.toggleDevTools.context: View menu, shown only when developer tools are allowed: opens or closes Chromium's developer tools.

@menu.machine.configure.context: Machine menu, first item: opens the Machine page of the Settings dialog, which holds the running machine's own options (ROMs, screen and sound options). The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

placeholders.machine: Name of the running machine, shown verbatim, e.g. 'ZX Spectrum 48K'

@menu.machine.configureUnknown.context: Machine menu, first item, when the running machine's name is unknown: opens the Machine page of the Settings dialog. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.machine.machineType.context: Machine menu: submenu listing the favourite emulated machines (ZX Spectrum 48K, ZX Spectrum Next...).

@menu.machine.selectMachine.context: Machine › Machine Type: opens the dialog listing every emulated machine. Keep the ellipsis.

@menu.machine.start.context: Machine menu: starts (or continues) running the emulated machine.

@menu.machine.pause.context: Machine menu: pauses the running emulated machine.

@menu.machine.stop.context: Machine menu: stops the emulated machine.

@menu.machine.restart.context: Machine menu: stops and starts the emulated machine again.

@menu.machine.speed.context: Machine menu: submenu choosing how many times faster than the real hardware the machine runs.

@menu.machine.sound.context: Machine menu: submenu choosing the sound volume.

@menu.machine.inputSettings.context: Machine › Input: opens the Input page of the Settings dialog. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.machine.device.tape.context: Machine menu: submenu of the emulated cassette tape (insert, rewind, eject).

@menu.machine.device.program.context: Machine menu (ZX80/ZX81): submenu that loads and runs a program file.

@menu.machine.device.disks.context: Machine menu: submenu of the emulated floppy disk drives.

@menu.machine.device.cartridge.context: Machine menu (Timex 2068): submenu of the cartridge (DOCK) slot.

@menu.machine.device.sdCard.context: Machine menu (ZX Spectrum Next): submenu of the SD card image.

@menu.machine.device.input.context: Machine menu: submenu of input devices (keyboard settings, joystick, mouse).

@menu.machine.hardware.context: Machine menu: submenu of the machine's own hardware actions, used when the machine has no name to show instead.

@menu.machine.record.context: Machine menu: submenu of the recordings (video, IDE + emulator, RZX). 'Record' is a noun/verb here: the recording commands.

@menu.machine.startVideo.context: Machine › Record: starts recording the emulated screen to a video file.

@menu.machine.stopVideo.context: Machine › Record: stops the video recording and saves it.

@menu.machine.pauseVideo.context: Machine › Record: pauses the video recording.

@menu.machine.continueVideo.context: Machine › Record: continues a paused video recording.

@menu.machine.startIdeEmu.context: Machine › Record: starts a video of both windows, the IDE and the emulator, side by side.

@menu.machine.stopIdeEmu.context: Machine › Record: stops the video of both windows.

@menu.machine.recordingSettings.context: Machine › Record: opens the Recording page of the Settings dialog. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.startDebugging.context: Debug menu: starts the emulated machine with breakpoints active.

@menu.debug.stepInto.context: Debug menu: executes one Z80 instruction, entering a called subroutine.

@menu.debug.stepOver.context: Debug menu: executes one instruction; a CALL runs to its return.

@menu.debug.stepOut.context: Debug menu: runs until the current subroutine returns.

@menu.debug.stepOverLine.context: Debug menu: executes one source line (BASIC or assembly) of a program with source-level debug information.

@menu.debug.stepBack.context: Debug menu: moves back one instruction in the recorded execution history (reverse debugging).

@menu.debug.stepForward.context: Debug menu: moves forward one instruction in the recorded execution history.

@menu.debug.reverseStepOver.context: Debug menu: the reverse of Step Over, through the recorded history.

@menu.debug.reverseStepOut.context: Debug menu: goes back to where the current subroutine was called, through the recorded history.

@menu.debug.reverseContinue.context: Debug menu: runs backwards through the recorded history to the previous breakpoint.

@menu.debug.returnToPresent.context: Debug menu: leaves the recorded history and returns to the machine's current state.

@menu.debug.executionHistory.context: Debug menu: opens the document listing the recently executed instructions.

@menu.debug.exportHistory.context: Debug menu: saves the recorded instruction trace to a file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.codeCoverage.context: Debug menu checkbox: records which memory addresses were executed, read and written.

@menu.debug.resetCoverage.context: Debug menu: clears the recorded code coverage.

@menu.debug.detectCodeData.context: Debug menu: marks memory as code or data from the coverage, for disassembly. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.startProfiling.context: Debug menu: starts measuring where the program spends its time.

@menu.debug.stopProfiling.context: Debug menu: stops measuring and opens the Profiler.

@menu.debug.profiler.context: Debug menu: opens the Profiler document.

@menu.debug.saveDebugRecording.context: Debug menu: saves the reverse-debugging session to a file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.openDebugRecording.context: Debug menu: opens a saved reverse-debugging session. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.syncSource.context: Debug menu checkbox: when the machine stops at a breakpoint, the source editor jumps to that line.

@menu.debug.debuggerSettings.context: Debug menu: opens the Debugging page of the Settings dialog. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.help.aboutKlive.context: Help menu (Windows/Linux): opens the About dialog. 'Klive' is the product name.

@menu.help.homePage.context: Help menu: opens Klive's website in the browser.

@menu.help.welcome.context: Help menu: shows the welcome dialog shown at the first start.

@menu.help.machineResources.context: Help menu: submenu of web links about the emulated machine.

placeholders.machine: Machine name, shown verbatim, e.g. 'Cambridge Z88'

@menu.help.z88.userGuide.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.help.z88.developersNotes.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

menu.help.z88.bbcBasicGuide: BBC BASIC (Z80) Reference Guide for Z88

@menu.help.z88.bbcBasicGuide.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.help.z88.romSource.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.help.z88.thirdPartyApps.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.help.z88.toolsAndGames.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.help.z88.wikipedia.context: Help › Cambridge Z88 Resources: a web link to a document or site. Keep product and document names (Cambridge Z88, BBC BASIC, OZ) as they are.

@menu.tape.rewind.context: Machine › Tape: rewinds the emulated cassette tape to its start.

@menu.tape.insert.context: Machine › Tape: picks a tape file (.tap/.tzx) to put in the emulated cassette player. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.tape.eject.context: Machine › Tape: removes the tape from the emulated cassette player.

@menu.tape.fastLoad.context: Machine › Tape / Program checkbox: loads programs instantly instead of at the real tape speed.

@menu.tape.loadAndRun.context: Machine › Tape (Enterprise 64/128): restarts the machine, loads the program on the tape in the emulated cassette player and runs it.

@menu.spectrum.snowEffect.context: Machine menu of the ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K, a checked menu item: shows the speckles ('snow') the real machine's picture shows while the I register points at contended memory.

@menu.spectrum.lateUlaTiming.context: Machine menu of the ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K, a checked menu item: runs the ULA (the video chip; keep the name) one T-state later, as many real machines do.

@menu.program.select.context: Machine › Program (ZX80/ZX81): picks the program file (.p/.o) the machine loads. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.program.loadAndRun.context: Machine › Program (ZX80/ZX81): resets the machine, loads the selected program and runs it.

@menu.program.rewind.context: Machine › Program (ZX80/ZX81): rewinds the emulated tape that holds the program.

@menu.program.eject.context: Machine › Program (ZX80/ZX81): removes the selected program file.

@menu.disk.floppyDisks.context: Machine › Disks: submenu of the emulated floppy drives.

@menu.disk.createDiskFile.context: Machine › Disks: creates an empty floppy disk image file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.disk.bootDriveA.context: Machine › Disks (Pentagon, Scorpion): starts the disk in drive A through TR-DOS. 'A' is the drive letter.

@menu.disk.saveAsTrd.context: Machine › Disks: saves the disk in a drive as a TR-DOS '.trd' image file. Keep '.trd'. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.disk.eject.context: Machine › Disks: removes the disk from a floppy drive.

@menu.disk.writeProtect.context: Machine › Disks checkbox: prevents the emulated machine writing to the disk in a drive.

@menu.disk.change.context: Machine › Disks: replaces the disk in a drive with another disk image file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.disk.insert.context: Machine › Disks: puts a disk image file into an empty drive. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.spectrum.basicListing.context: View › Machine Views checkbox: shows the ZX Spectrum BASIC program in memory as a listing.

@menu.timex.drivenBy.context: Machine › Input › Kempston Joystick: submenu choosing which host device (keyboard, gamepad) plays the joystick.

@menu.timex.sideDrivenBy.context: Machine › Input › Joysticks (Timex 2068): submenu choosing which host device plays one joystick.

placeholders.joystick: The joystick's name as shown elsewhere, e.g. 'Joystick 1 (left)'

@menu.timex.joysticks.context: Machine › Input (Timex 2068): submenu of the two joysticks.

@menu.timex.kempstonJoystick.context: Machine › Input (Timex TC2048): submenu of the built-in Kempston joystick port. 'Kempston' is a product name.

@menu.joystick.configureBindings.context: Machine › Input › Joystick: opens the dialog assigning host keys and gamepad buttons to the joystick. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.timex.changeCartridge.context: Machine › Cartridge (Timex 2068): replaces the cartridge in the DOCK slot. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

placeholders.file: The inserted cartridge's file name, shown verbatim, e.g. 'game.dck'

@menu.timex.insertCartridge.context: Machine › Cartridge (Timex 2068): puts a cartridge file (.dck) into the DOCK slot. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.ht1080z.resetKey.context: Machine › HT-1080Z (a Hungarian school computer): presses the RESET key on the machine's back panel, which takes BASIC back to its READY prompt and keeps the program in memory. RESET is the key's label: keep it in capitals.

@menu.ht1080z.pageKey.context: Machine › HT-1080Z: presses the PAGE key once. In 32-column mode it switches between the left and right halves of each screen row, and it stays latched until pressed again. PAGE is the key's label: keep it in capitals.

@menu.ht1080z.videoCut.context: Machine › HT-1080Z, a checked menu item: the machine's VIDEO CUT switch, which blanks the picture while programs keep running. VIDEO CUT is the switch's label on the machine: keep it in capitals, untranslated.

@menu.ht1080z.cpuDash.context: Machine › HT-1080Z, a checked menu item: when on, a CPU read or write of video memory blanks a short dash on the screen at the beam position, as the real hardware does.

@menu.z88.softReset.context: Machine › Cambridge Z88: resets the machine keeping its memory (like the reset button).

@menu.z88.hardReset.context: Machine › Cambridge Z88: resets the machine and clears its memory.

@menu.z88.pressBothShifts.context: Machine › Cambridge Z88: presses both SHIFT keys at once (switches the Z88 on or off). Keep 'SHIFT' as the key's name.

@menu.z88.batteryLow.context: Machine › Cambridge Z88: makes the machine believe its batteries are low (for testing programs).

@menu.rzx.record.context: Machine › Record: starts an RZX input recording. 'RZX' is a file format; keep it and the colon.

@menu.rzx.stopAndSave.context: Machine › Record: stops the RZX recording and saves it. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.rzx.insertRollbackPoint.context: Machine › Record: marks a point in the RZX recording that 'Roll Back' can return to.

@menu.rzx.rollBack.context: Machine › Record: returns the RZX recording (and the machine) to the last rollback point.

menu.rzx.renderToVideo: RZX: Render a Recording to Video...

@menu.rzx.renderToVideo.context: Machine › Record: plays an RZX recording into a video file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.next.selectImage.context: Machine › SD Card (ZX Spectrum Next): picks an SD card image file. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.next.useDefaultImage.context: Machine › SD Card: switches back to Klive's own SD card image.

@menu.next.resetDefaultImage.context: Machine › SD Card: restores Klive's own SD card image to its original content (asks first). The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.next.hotkeys.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next: submenu of the real machine's function-key actions (F1-F10).

@menu.next.hotkey.f1.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f2.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator. The scandoubler doubles the video lines for VGA output.

@menu.next.hotkey.f3.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f4.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f5.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f6.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f7.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator. Scanlines imitate a CRT's dark lines.

@menu.next.hotkey.f8.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator.

@menu.next.hotkey.f9.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator. 'Multiface' is a product name, 'NMI' the non-maskable interrupt.

@menu.next.hotkey.f10.context: Machine › ZX Spectrum Next › Hotkeys: the action of a function key on the real machine. Keep the key name and the ' - ' separator. 'DivMMC' is a product name, 'NMI' the non-maskable interrupt.

@menu.next.copperList.context: View › Machine Views (ZX Spectrum Next): opens the Copper program document. 'Copper' is the name of the Next's display coprocessor; keep it.

@menu.next.spriteInspector.context: View › Machine Views (ZX Spectrum Next): opens the panel showing the hardware sprites.

@menu.next.tilemapInspector.context: View › Machine Views (ZX Spectrum Next): opens the panel showing the tilemap layer.

@menu.next.layer2Inspector.context: View › Machine Views (ZX Spectrum Next): opens the panel showing the 'Layer 2' bitmap layer. 'Layer 2' is a hardware name; keep it.

@menu.next.layers.context: View › Machine Views (ZX Spectrum Next): opens the document showing how the video layers combine.

@menu.next.stepCopper.context: Debug menu (ZX Spectrum Next): runs the Copper display coprocessor one instruction. Keep 'Copper'.

@menu.next.mouse.context: Machine › Input (ZX Spectrum Next): submenu of the emulated mouse.

@menu.next.captureMouse.context: Machine › Input › Mouse checkbox: allows the emulated machine to take over the host mouse.

@menu.next.showCapturedPointer.context: Machine › Input › Mouse: submenu choosing when the host's pointer stays visible while the mouse is captured.

@menu.next.sensitivity.context: Machine › Input › Mouse: submenu choosing the mouse speed; the current choice is in brackets.

placeholders.level: The current sensitivity as shown in the submenu, e.g. 'Normal (1x)'

@menu.next.joystick.context: Machine › Input (ZX Spectrum Next): submenu of the two joystick connectors.

@menu.next.drivenBy.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › one joystick: submenu choosing which host device (keyboard, gamepad) plays it.

menu.next.setMachineMode: Set machine mode (NextReg $05, NextZXOS may override)

@menu.next.setMachineMode.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › one joystick: submenu writing the joystick type into the machine's register. Keep 'NextReg $05' and 'NextZXOS' (technical names).

@menu.next.joystickMode.sinclair2.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'.

@menu.next.joystickMode.kempston1.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'.

@menu.next.joystickMode.cursor.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'.

@menu.next.joystickMode.sinclair1.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'.

@menu.next.joystickMode.kempston2.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'.

@menu.next.joystickMode.md1.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'. 'MD' is the Mega Drive pad.

@menu.next.joystickMode.md2.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'. 'MD' is the Mega Drive pad.

@menu.next.joystickMode.userDefined.context: Machine › Input › Joystick › Set machine mode: a joystick type of the ZX Spectrum Next. Keep product names (Sinclair, Kempston, Protek, MD) and port numbers like '$1F'. 'joymap' is the name of the key map; keep it.

@menu.debug.exportDisassemblySource.context: Debug menu: writes the annotated disassembly of the 64K view's RAM ($4000-$FFFF) as a Klive Z80 assembly file, then assembles it to check it gives the same bytes. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.debug.romAnnotations.context: Debug menu: a submenu with one submenu per machine type, each listing the ROM files Klive ships for that machine; picking one opens that ROM's annotations (its labels, comments and data regions, which the user can edit) in the ROM annotation editor of the IDE window.

@menu.debug.romAnnotationsPage.context: Debug › ROM Annotations › (machine type): an item for one 16K page of a ROM file that holds several pages (the ZX Spectrum Next's 64K NextZXOS ROM). Picking it opens that page's annotations.

placeholders.file: The ROM file's name, shown verbatim, e.g. 'enNextZX.rom'
placeholders.page: The page's number within the file, from 0

@menu.debug.romAnnotationsFailed.context: Title of the error message box shown when an item of Debug › ROM Annotations cannot open the ROM's annotations; the message below it says why. Use the same words as the 'ROM Annotations' submenu.

@menu.divMmc.connect.context: Checkbox, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: connects the DivMMC to the machine, which restarts. Usually left untranslated.

@menu.divMmc.selectRom.context: Menu item, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: names the 8K esxDOS ROM file, which Klive cannot ship.

@menu.divMmc.changeRom.context: Menu item, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: names another esxDOS ROM file.

@menu.divMmc.selectImage.context: Menu item, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: picks the SD card image file (.img, .hdf or .cim).

@menu.divMmc.useDefaultImage.context: Menu item, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: goes back to Klive's default SD card image.

@menu.divMmc.nmi.context: Menu item, an item of the Machine › Interfaces submenu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K) or the Machine › SD Card submenu (+2A/+3), where the DivMMC interface (an SD card interface that runs the esxDOS operating system) is set up: presses the DivMMC's NMI button, which opens esxDOS's NMI menu. NMI: non-maskable interrupt, usually left untranslated.

@menu.machine.device.interfaces.context: Machine menu (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K): submenu of the add-on interfaces that plug into the edge connector - the DivMMC (an SD card interface) and the ZX Interface 1 with its Microdrives (small tape-loop cartridge drives); one of them at a time.

@menu.tvc.hbf.context: Checkbox in the Videoton TVC's Machine menu: plugs the HBF floppy disk interface card (with its VT-DOS ROM) into the machine, which restarts it. HBF and VT-DOS are product names.

@menu.ep.cartridge.context: Checkbox in the Enterprise 64/128's Machine menu: puts the IS-BASIC cartridge into the machine's cartridge slot (without it the machine starts its built-in word processor); changing it restarts the machine. IS-BASIC is a product name.

@menu.ep.hostFs.context: Checkbox in the Enterprise 64/128's Machine menu: fits Klive's FILE: device, which lets the emulated machine load and save files in a folder on the user's computer (BASIC's LOAD "FILE:name"); changing it restarts the machine. FILE: is the device name the user types and stays untranslated.

@menu.ep.openFileFolder.context: Menu item in the Enterprise 64/128's Machine menu: opens, in the computer's file manager, the folder whose files the emulated machine's FILE: device reads and writes. FILE: is a device name and stays untranslated.

@menu.ep.linearPalette.context: Checkbox in the Enterprise 64/128's Machine menu: draws the machine's colours with evenly spaced brightness levels instead of the levels the real circuit board's resistors produce; changing it restarts the machine.

@menu.ep.exdos.context: Checkbox in the Enterprise 64/128's Machine menu: fits the EXDOS floppy disk interface card (with its EXDOS ROM), which adds two floppy drives; changing it restarts the machine. EXDOS is a product name and stays untranslated.

@menu.if1.connect.context: Checkbox, the first item of Machine › Microdrives on the ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K: connects the ZX Interface 1 (Sinclair's add-on that drives Microdrives), which restarts the machine. A product name; usually left untranslated.

@menu.if1.fast.context: Checkbox, Machine › Microdrives: while a Microdrive's motor runs, the emulator runs as fast as it can, so cartridge operations take less waiting; the emulated timing is unchanged.

@menu.if1.insert.context: Machine › Microdrives: opens a file dialog to put an '.mdr' cartridge image into a Microdrive. The trailing '...' means the item opens a dialog; keep it.

@menu.if1.change.context: Machine › Microdrives: as 'Insert Cartridge', when the drive already holds one. Keep the '...'.

@menu.if1.newBlank.context: Machine › Microdrives: asks for a file name, creates an unformatted '.mdr' cartridge there (the emulated machine's FORMAT command prepares it) and puts it into the drive. Keep the '...'.

@menu.if1.saveAs.context: Machine › Microdrives: saves the cartridge in a drive, as the emulated machine left it, to a new '.mdr' file. Keep the '...'.

@menu.if1.eject.context: Machine › Microdrives: takes the cartridge out of a drive.

@menu.if1.writeProtect.context: Checkbox, Machine › Microdrives: the cartridge's write-protect tab; while it is on, the emulated machine cannot write the cartridge.

@menu.if1.boot.context: Machine › Interfaces (ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K, Interface 1 connected): resets the machine and types RUN, which makes the Interface 1 load and run the program called 'run' from the cartridge in Microdrive 1.

@menu.next.soundOutput.context: Machine › Sound (ZX Spectrum Next): submenu choosing which of the Next's sound outputs the emulator plays (audio jack, internal speaker or HDMI). It sits under the volume levels of the Sound menu, so 'Output' means the sound output.
